content.stem: 台湾一家赌场的合规官发现，该赌场在连续几天收到一名顾客多笔略低于大额交易报告（LTR）限额的现金存款，且该顾客使用了三个不同的投注账户。下一步应采取什么恰当措施？

options.A: 在客户账户中记录,该客户的赌博活动经常在报告限额以下进行.
options.B: 按照内部报告程序将该活动作为可疑行为上报,并向相关主管部门报告
options.C: 告知客户其活动存在可疑之处，并要求其作出解释
options.D: 联系执法部门对客户的财务活动展开调查

content.stem_en: The compliance officer at a casino in Taiwan discovers that the casino received multiple cash deposits from a customer just below the Large-Amount Transaction Report (LTR) limit on consecutive days. The customer used three different betting accounts. What is the appropriate next step?

options_en.A: Make a note in the customer's account that the customer's gambling activities are frequently conducted below the reporting limit
options_en.B: Follow internal reporting procedures to escalate the activity as suspicious and report to appropriate authorities
options_en.C: Inform the customer that their activity is suspicious and request an explanation
options_en.D: Contact law enforcement to investigate the customer's financial activity
